name: housetrip (API Evangelist profile)
what_it_holds: API Evangelist profile of the now-defunct HouseTrip (London-based vacation-rental marketplace, acquired/shut down years ago) — documents its historical public API surface, no live data.
why_useful: Marginal: HouseTrip is defunct so its API is not pullable; historical interest only for STR-competitor landscape context (gap #9), not actionable data.

name: tourism-chatbot-getyourguide

why_useful: Very marginal — no persisted dataset described, scraping logic buried inside a chatbot app; would need code inspection to extract the scraping piece.

name: rapid-java-sdk
what_it_holds: Official Expedia Group open-source Kotlin/Java SDK (Apache-2.0) for the Rapid API (formerly EPS - Expedia Partner Solutions), which since Expedia's platform unification exposes lodging supply/rates across Expedia's Brand Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo and other properties through one partner API. This is a client library, not data; Rapid API access requires an Expedia Partner Solutions/affiliate contract and API key (not free/self-serve), so it is a documented pull method only if the team can obtain partner credentials.
why_useful: The most authoritative possible pointer to Expedia Group's actual vacation-rental (Vrbo) supply/pricing feed (gap #9), directly from Expedia Group's own GitHub org - but practically gated behind a partner agreement, so not usable without a business relationship the team likely does not have.
themes: Vrbo / HomeAway datasets and scrapers, Vrbo listing snapshots, Expedia Group vacation rental supply data
why_all: The most authoritative possible pointer to Expedia Group's actual vacation-rental (Vrbo) supply/pricing feed (gap #9), directly from Expedia Group's own GitHub org - but practically gated behind a partner agreement, so not usable without a business relationship the team likely does not have.

name: channex-mcp
what_it_holds: MCP server wrapping the Channex channel-manager API (properties, room_types, rate_plans) which syncs inventory/rates across many OTAs including Vrbo, Booking.com and Airbnb for property managers. Found via github.com/topics/short-term-rental (5 stars); not independently verified in depth.
why_useful: A channel-manager-side integration point that could in principle expose cross-platform (including Vrbo) rate-plan data if the operator has a Channex account, but this is host-side tooling requiring the team to control listings - not a public dataset.
themes: Vrbo / HomeAway datasets and scrapers, Vrbo listing snapshots, Expedia Group vacation rental supply data
wildcard: an Airbnb superhost / small property manager who uses open-s
why_all: A channel-manager-side integration point that could in principle expose cross-platform (including Vrbo) rate-plan data if the operator has a Channex account, but this is host-side tooling requiring the team to control listings - not a public dataset.

Channex sits between many small PMs and every major OTA at once; its rate-plan/ARI (availability-rate-inventory) objects are the same data a host pushes to Airbnb, so the schema shows what a cross-OTA comp/rate panel would need to look like. Requires the operator's own Channex credentials; no public data.
